derivation.rule: value = (misses+1)/(observed+1) over the S1-era admission decisions (ledgered decisions joined to the S1 corpus heads) and their observed outcomes, ceiled to 4 decimals, computed by admission_miss_rate.admission_miss_rate_e0 under metric_definitions.admission_miss_rate; the +1 keeps a zero-miss baseline a satisfiable strict ceiling at the S1 sample size. S3's miss rate must stay strictly under it. FAIL_CLOSED STAGE_THRESHOLD_BASELINE_INSUFFICIENT if the baseline is unobserved (UNKNOWN), observed < min_observations, or the value is vacuous (>= 1).

admission_miss_rate.decision_population: admission decisions that are organization-ledger receipts (LEDGER_RECEIPT_REF): ALLOW (e.g. ORGANIZATION_MAIN_MERGE_TRANSFER), DENY and FAIL_CLOSED admission outcomes; each with its ledger_seq and the change it decided (repository, head commit, change digest, base)
admission_miss_rate.held: a decision named by a sealed stegverse.admission_outcome.v1 record with outcome HELD whose evidence_ref is an organization-ledger receipt; a miss for the same decision wins and the contradiction is recorded
admission_miss_rate.learning_path: every counted miss -> admission_learning.harvest -> generalize -> generate -> corpus_append (SCENARIO_CORPUS_APPEND), resident-runtime/admission_miss_rate.py::learn_from_misses

miss.FALSE_ADMIT: an ALLOW decision named (admission_receipt_ref) by a sealed stegverse.admission_miss.v1 record (admission_learning.admission_miss) of a kind in false_admit_miss_kinds whose correcting_ref is an organization-ledger receipt: the admitted change was later reverted, corrected or refused
miss.FALSE_REFUSAL: a DENY decision for a change digest at a base followed, later in the ledger, by an ALLOW decision for the same change digest at the same base: nothing differed, so the refusal was the miss

admission_miss_rate.not_applicable: a FAIL_CLOSED decision (evidence missing; a later ALLOW after the evidence is appended is the designed path)
admission_miss_rate.unknown: every other decision; UNKNOWN is never counted as HELD (no absence of a revert is read as an outcome) and is excluded from the rate
admission_miss_rate.unobserved: observed outcomes < min_observed_outcomes: FAIL_CLOSED ADMISSION_MISS_RATE_UNOBSERVED with six fields, admission_miss_rate UNKNOWN; no rate is defaulted

name: BOUNDED_SOLVING
thresholds_source: this manifest only; value is written solely by the declared STAGE_THRESHOLD_DERIVE transition (resident-runtime/stage_threshold_derive.py, scripts/derive_stage_thresholds.py) from threshold.derivation, never by hand; a null value is undeclared and the gate FAIL_CLOSES STAGE_THRESHOLD_UNDECLARED
